sonnet.problem: The card says "The crowd is furious" as a plain fact. The text only says they seized Jeremiah and shouted. A feeling stated as fact, not marked as Papa Dorin's own guess.
sonnet.rule: He can guess at a feeling, marked as his own ("I think," "I bet"). Never as fact.

sonnet.problem: The card says "the same people who grabbed him just flipped." In 26:8 the priests, prophets and all the people seized Jeremiah. The officials arrived later (26:10) and were not among those who grabbed him. Saying the same people who grabbed him now say he is not worthy of death stretches the text.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
